# SYNESIS_E032 — Error

## Description

Value `value` in `field_name` contains spaces. Suggested fix -> `value`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The value `value` of the field `field_name` contains spaces, which
  is not allowed in TOPIC fields. Spaces are read as
  separators and would make the grouping ambiguous.
  Use underscores instead of spaces. For example: `value`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **TopicWithSpaces**: `field_name`, `value`
